title: Late and Returned Payment Fees: Home Comfort Financing Account Terms
content:
Account terms of Home Comfort Financing on late payments, returned payments and the fees that attach to them.

## Late fees

**L1 — When a late fee may be charged.** A late fee is charged only when the required payment is still unpaid more than the plan's late-fee grace period (in calendar days) after its due date. Late-fee days are counted as calendar days with the due date as day 0. The due day and the statement month are read from the account's records.

**L2 — Amount (retired).** The clause "The late fee is the plan's late fee amount, never more than the plan's late-fee ceiling percentage of the payment that was due" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded and is no longer the basis for the amount of a late fee.

**L3 — One per statement period.** Only one late fee is charged per statement period; a statement period that already carries a late fee on the account's records is not charged a second one.

## Returned payments

**R1 — Fee per returned payment (retired).** The clause "Each returned payment is charged one returned-payment fee of the plan's returned-payment fee amount naming that payment" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded and is no longer the basis for the returned-payment fee.

**R2 — Effect on the installment.** A returned payment also leaves the payment it replaced unpaid, so a late fee may follow if the grace period then passes.

**R3 — Removal of autopay.** When the plan's removal figure of autopay payments have been returned within 12 months, autopay is removed and any autopay APR reduction ends with it. The count is of returned-payment entries on the account whose returned payment was an autopay draft, in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date of handling.

## Grace period — boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 10-day grace period)

The payment is due on the 5th, which is day 0.

| Payment still unpaid on | Day count | More than 10 days after the due date? | Late fee may be charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 15th | day 10 | no — equal, not more | no |
| the 16th | day 11 | yes | yes |

## Returned payment and the grace period — illustration (hypothetical)

A payment made on the 3rd for an installment due on the 5th is returned by the borrower's bank on the 12th. The installment it paid is unpaid again. If it is still unpaid on day 11 after the due date, the conditions of L1 are met and a late fee may follow, subject to L3.

## Autopay removal — illustration (hypothetical, a removal figure of 2)

An account on a plan whose removal figure is 2 has had one autopay draft returned in March and a second returned in November of the same year. Two autopay payments have been returned within 12 months, so autopay is removed, and any autopay APR reduction ends with it.

superseded_clauses: The late fee is late_fee_usd, never more than late_fee_max_pct_of_payment_due percent of the payment that was due
Each returned payment is charged one returned_payment_fee of returned_payment_fee_usd naming that payment
